jobs.prompt: Production UI assets for a Japanese TV anime summer-town life game. Match the reference palette and confident clean outlines ONLY: restrained ivory washi, pale sage mint, warm muted gold and dark teal. Matte cel illustration, precise silhouettes, refined thin edging, almost invisible paper fibres. No photorealism, no 3D bevel, no text, no letters, no watermark. True transparent PNG alpha background. An atlas with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows, eight separate blank horizontal rounded buttons, each centered within an equal cell and fully isolated by large transparent gutters. All buttons have the SAME dimensions and geometry, horizontal 3.5:1 capsules, restrained thin hairline contour and small softly feathered ambient shadow. Top row is PRIMARY sage-green button states from left to right: normal soft sage; hover lighter fresh mint with a delicate gold highlight; pressed deeper sage with a quiet darker inner edge; disabled desaturated grey-sage. Bottom row is SECONDARY ivory-paper button states: normal warm ivory; hover ivory with a delicate mint edge; pressed slightly warmer pale ochre ivory; disabled soft grey-ivory. Minimal tiny end marks consistent with Japanese stationery, no ornate decorations. Borders and corner information stay at the ends so these can be nine-sliced. Keep central areas completely blank. Every button stays inside the central 80% width and 26% height of its cell. Deliver the eight-state atlas only.
